description: Implementation of NoteRepository interface handling note data operations, synchronization with backend, and data persistence via DAOs in an Android app.

classes.name: NoteRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of NoteRepository that manages notes, including CRUD operations, synchronization, and local/remote data management.

methods.name: syncNotes
methods.description: Performs synchronization between local notes and remote backend, handling conflict resolution and updates.

methods.name: applyLocalUpdates
methods.description: Applies local note actions (create, update, delete) and updates local database accordingly.

methods.name: applyRemoteUpdates
methods.description: Applies remote note actions received from backend to local data via processing commands.

methods.name: applyMappingChanges
methods.description: Updates ID mappings based on synchronization result.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into local database and optionally triggers remote sync.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Updates one or more notes locally and optionally syncs with remote backend.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a single note locally and optionally syncs with remote backend.

methods.name: moveNotesToBin
methods.description: Moves notes to trash/deleted state and optionally deletes remote notes.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores notes from trash, updating local database and syncing remote if needed.

methods.name: deleteNotes
methods.description: Permanently deletes notes from local database and remote backend if specified.

methods.name: discardEmptyNotes
methods.description: Deletes notes with empty titles.

methods.name: permanentlyDeleteNotesInBin
methods.description: Permanently deletes all notes in the trash bin.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID as a Flow.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Returns a Flow of deleted notes.

methods.name: getArchived
methods.description: Returns a Flow of archived notes.

methods.name: getNonDeleted
methods.description: Returns a Flow of non-deleted notes.

methods.name: getNonDeletedOrArchived
methods.description: Returns a Flow of non-deleted or archived notes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow of all notes.

methods.name: getByNotebook
methods.description: Returns notes associated with a specific notebook.

methods.name: getNonRemoteNotes
methods.description: Returns notes not synchronized with a specific cloud service.

methods.name: getNotesWithoutNotebook
methods.description: Returns notes that are not assigned to any notebook.

methods.name: getNotesByCloudService
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of note ID mappings to notes for a specified cloud service.

methods.name: deleteIdMappingsForCloudService
methods.description: Deletes all ID mappings for a specified cloud service.
